adjustments: Only replacement atlas textures; skeleton JSON byte-identical including attachments, slots, draw order, animations and timing
16 original part canvases re-traced into 48 individually registered 2x PNGs across 3 styles
Painted shared palette; no slot tint or darkColor overrides
Native full actions at 30fps with PA1-style trimmed 256px atlas packaging

samples.region: 主角发梢外轮廓，距透明边缘不超过两像素

paintedPalette.decision: 以主角实测 #3c2b23 为三样稿唯一描边/点眼色；拾荒者两个实测暖深棕样本作为深度与暖度对照，不逐样稿改变线色。所有色彩直接绘入 PNG，不用 slot tint。

imagegen.promptSummary: 16 separate D1 a/c/d texture parts in original 4x4 registration grid; cream #f4edda, beige #cbb694, cyan #78b9c4, thin single brown #3c2b23 outlines, point eyes with one white highlight, closed eyes on body, open eyes in yan, transparent background; same contour as style1 with one narrow soft-edge shadow
imagegen.postprocess: Hand re-trace original part coordinate silhouettes and facial registration; no generated complete-character pose used as runtime animation.
